passengers.name: Agnes
passengers.motivation: My grandson's ferry leaves at quarter to. I finished his scarf.
passengers.onTime: She reached the gangway with a minute to spare. The scarf is very long.
passengers.late: The ferry was already lights on the water. She'll post it tomorrow.
passengers.notReached: She got off at the last stop and stood for a while.

passengers.name: Tomás
passengers.motivation: Night baker. Third late shift this month and they'll stop asking why.
passengers.onTime: Ovens on at 00:45. The first loaf is always his.
passengers.late: The manager said nothing. That was worse.
passengers.notReached: He called in. He's never called in before.

passengers.name: Priya
passengers.motivation: Our band's first real gig. We're on at half past.
passengers.onTime: They opened with the song she wrote on this train.
passengers.late: They let her band play last, to six people. She says it still counted.
passengers.notReached: She heard the set on a friend's phone, on the platform.
